decisions.reason: After several years with no visible market presence, this automation module appears not to have met the firm's now higher aspirations strongly enough as a standalone offer, so resources would be better redirected to core integrated systems and newer development.

Although close to the established offer, the prolonged absence of clear market presentation suggests results below aspiration for this product line, making withdrawal and redeployment of engineering and sales attention the more likely choice.

Its initial strategic importance was not sustained in later years, and a medium-sized German machinery firm following a focused portfolio logic would likely discontinue this formwork line if it no longer justifies dedicated support.

This component fits the core business, but with no continuing sign of active promotion after launch, management would likely judge that it has fallen short of aspiration and reallocate slack to stronger offerings and new projects.

As the narrowest and least prominent of the remaining launches, it is the most likely to be withdrawn once continued uncertainty and weak visibility make its opportunity cost too high for the firm's planned growth path.
